**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Human Capital**
 Our Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. We guide teams in reimagining work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise, and help in transforming HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help provide insights and enable delivery to address questions such as: How do organizations access, develop, and motivate their workforce? What should the AI strategy be for the HR function? Do they have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to help make work better for humans and humans better at work
   

  

**Level: Senior Consultant**
 As a Senior Consultant in Organization Design, you will lead and manage complex projects that help our clients align their organizational structure, operating model, and talent strategy to evolving business needs. Leveraging advanced analytical tools and your experience, you’ll coach teams, ensure quality delivery, and cultivate high\-performing, collaborative environments.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 Responsibilities include but are not limited to
   

  

* Develop and implement organization design strategies that support future\-state organization structures and service delivery needs

* Support governance, decision rights, workforce transition planning, job design, competency modeling, and career path development
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients while managing project plans, quality reviews, resource allocation, and timely deliverable completion
* Champion the responsible use of generative artificial intelligence and automation to improve delivery efficiency, accelerate analysis, and enhance solution quality and scalability


**The team:**

It will require a combination of change management actions to execute the transformation. **Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

* Project management certification such as Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, or Agile

* Bachelor’s degree

 Chennai, India
   

  

 At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
   

  

****Job Description****
**About the Role**
 We are seeking a Learning \& Development (L\&D) Specialist to support employee development initiatives, initially focused on our India campus, with the opportunity to scale programs globally. This role will design, coordinate, facilitate, and continuously improve learning programs that support onboarding, career development, leadership growth, and employee performance.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director, Organizational Development in Canada, the ideal candidate is passionate about creating engaging learning experiences, building scalable programs, and partnering effectively with leaders and subject matter experts across regions. As part of a global HR team, this role requires the ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple time zones to deliver impactful learning solutions aligned with business objectives.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Employee Onboarding \& Integration**
* Manage and enhance the virtual employee onboarding program.
* Partner with business leaders and technical teams to develop role\-specific onboarding programs.
* Measure onboarding effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements.


**Career Development \& Career Pathing**
* Design and implement career development frameworks and career pathing tools to support employee career planning, skill development, and internal mobility.
* Partner with leaders to identify growth opportunities and development pathways for employees.


**Development (Leadership \& Employee)**
* Design, coordinate, and support leadership development programs for emerging and established leaders.
* Develop and deploy employee development programs that build critical professional and technical skills.
* Conduct learning needs assessments and recommend appropriate training solutions.
* Track participation, effectiveness, and learning outcomes using relevant metrics.


**Facilitation \& Program Delivery**
* Create and deliver engaging virtual and in\-person training programs, including the development of eLearning content and learning materials, to enhance employee skills, knowledge, and performance.
* Support local learning initiatives while maintaining alignment with global learning strategies.


**Program Design \& Global Scalability**
* Build learning programs that can be standardized, scaled, and deployed globally.
* Leverage learning technologies and digital platforms to maximize learner engagement and accessibility.


****Qualifications****
* Any Bachelor's degree with MBA or Post Graduation with specialization in Human Resources, Organizational Development or a related field from reputed Institutions.
* 7 years\+ of hard core experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or related discipline from Global / Multi National Companies with Matrix reporting structure.
* Experience in designing and managing onboarding, leadership, and employee development programs.
* Knowledge of career development frameworks and competency models.
* Strong instructional design and curriculum development skills.
* Experience facilitating virtual and instructor\-led learning programs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS), preferably Oracle, and digital learning platforms.


 Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

title: Chief People Officer (CHRO)
description:
**Position: Chief People Officer (CHRO) – Group HR** 
  





**Location:** 
 Chennai
   





**About the Role** 
  





 We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic HR leader to join our client’s organization as the Chief Human Resources Officer. The incumbent will lead the Human Resources function across the Group and its subsidiaries, driving people strategy, organizational effectiveness, talent acquisition, leadership development, workforce productivity, culture transformation, and HR governance.
   





 The ideal candidate will be a seasoned HR professional with extensive experience in large, professionally managed and listed organizations, preferably from Business Services, Hospitality, Healthcare Services, Logistics, Security Services, Retail, Telecom, Aviation, or other manpower\-intensive service industries.
   





 This role requires a dynamic leader who understands the complexities of managing large and geographically dispersed workforces while partnering closely with the Board, CEO, MD, and business leadership teams.
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  





**Strategic HR Leadership** 
  




* Develop and execute the Group's people strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Board, MD, CEO, and business leaders on all people\-related matters.
* Lead HR transformation initiatives, organization restructuring, workforce optimization, and change management programs.
* Build a high\-performance culture across all group entities.



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 
  




* Drive end\-to\-end talent acquisition strategy for corporate, leadership, and frontline workforce requirements.
* Develop robust hiring frameworks to support rapid business growth across multiple locations.
* Establish strong employer branding initiatives and recruitment excellence practices.
* Lead workforce planning and manpower budgeting across group companies.



**Leadership Hiring \& Succession Planning** 
  




* Design and implement succession planning frameworks for critical leadership positions.
* Identify and develop future leaders through structured talent review processes.
* Drive executive hiring and leadership assessment programs.



**HR Operations \& Governance** 
  




* Oversee all HR functions including Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Relations, Compensation \& Benefits, Learning \& Development, Performance Management, and HR Compliance.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, statutory regulations, and corporate governance requirements.
* Establish and monitor HR policies, systems, controls, and best practices across subsidiaries.



**Employee Relations \& Workforce Management** 
  




* Lead employee engagement, retention, productivity, and workforce stabilization initiatives.
* Manage large employee populations across multiple business units and locations.
* Drive harmonious industrial and employee relations across the organization.



**Compensation \& Rewards** 
  




* Design competitive compensation, benefits, and reward frameworks.
* Benchmark compensation structures against industry standards and market trends.
* Drive performance\-linked reward and recognition programs.



**HR Analytics \& Digital Transformation** 
  




* Leverage HR analytics and data\-driven decision\-making to improve workforce effectiveness.
* Drive digitization and automation of HR processes and systems.
* Develop dashboards and metrics to monitor organizational health and productivity.



**Desired Candidate Profile** 
  




* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* 20\+ years of progressive HR experience with at least 8\-10 years in senior leadership roles.
* Prior experience as CHRO, Group HR Head, Chief People Officer, EVP\-HR, or equivalent leadership position.
* Proven experience managing large employee populations (5,000\+ employees preferred).
* Demonstrated success in leading large HR teams across multiple locations.
* Strong expertise in Talent Acquisition and workforce planning.
* Experience working in listed companies and professionally managed corporate environments.
* Excellent understanding of labour laws, industrial relations, compensation strategy, and organizational development.
* Strong stakeholder management and board\-level presentation skills.

 **next\-gen enterprise software** 
 across
 **Global Payroll** 
 ,
 **HR** 
 ,
 **Aviation MRO** 
 ,
 **ERP** 
 , and
 **Logistics** 
 . Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35\+ countries and is recognized for its
 **AI/ML\-based** 
 ,
 **bot\-enabled** 
 , and
 **cloud\-native** 
 solutions.
 



 Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high\-growth enterprises alike.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
 **Ramco is the place to be.** 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 The
 **Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau** 
 oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high\-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.
 



 The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.
 



 The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Regional Compliance Ownership \& Governance** 



* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end\-to\-end statutory updates —
 **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release** 
 — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit\-ready documentation standards.



**Regulatory Interpretation \& Technical Oversight** 



* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi\-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.



**Leadership, Team Management \& Capability Building** 



* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Customer Confidence** 



* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end\-to\-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep\-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.



**Strategic Initiatives \& Innovation** 



* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI\-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought\-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future\-readiness.



**Training \& Knowledge Enablement** 



* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation\-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 



* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)** 




*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.* 



* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness** 
 — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
 *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy** 
 — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
 *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation** 
 — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit\-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality** 
 — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign\-off.
 *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance** 
 — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence** 
 — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep\-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement** 
 — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*



**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 



* Qualified
 **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer** 
 with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10\+ years in multi\-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi\-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.



**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI\-assisted regulatory research tooling.



**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS** 



* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35\+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast\-evolving, innovation\-led enterprise software company.

We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch\-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.
   

  

 That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.

 As a Human Resources Manager you will work closely with colleagues in the HRM team, our HR Business Partners, business partners and all HR Centres of Excellence to provide first class HR support to the ICON community locally and internationally.

title: Assistant Manager Human Resources
description:
About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager who has lived inside a high\-volume retail or QSR environment and knows what it takes to keep dozens of stores fully staffed, well\-trained and motivated. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-scale role, not a maintenance one. You'll own the full people lifecycle for our frontline and store\-management teams across three cities, and you'll be the person who makes sure our headcount keeps pace with our store rollout without sacrificing quality of hire.
 



 You'll partner directly with the MD, cluster managers and the training function, and you'll bring the systems, discipline and energy needed to run HR at scale across a distributed network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own high\-volume recruitment for store crew, shift leads and store managers across all three cities, building a pipeline that stays ahead of the store\-opening calendar.
* Build and maintain a sourcing engine (referrals, hyperlocal channels, institutes, gig platforms) that fills frontline roles fast and at the right cost\-per\-hire.
* Forecast manpower needs against the expansion plan and new\-store launch timelines.



**Retention \& Engagement** 



* Tackle frontline attrition head\-on — diagnose root causes, design interventions, and bring measurable improvement to retention and tenure.
* Run engagement, recognition and feedback mechanisms suited to a young, distributed, shift\-based workforce.



**Performance, Training \& Development** 



* Partner with the Head of Training to ensure every new hire moves through structured onboarding and sign\-off gates before going live on the floor.
* Drive a clear performance\-management rhythm across stores, including goal\-setting, reviews and career pathing for high performers.



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Own statutory and labour\-law compliance across all locations — Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESI, minimum wages, contract labour and store\-level documentation.
* Standardise HR processes, policies, SOPs and the HRIS so the system scales cleanly as store count grows.
* Manage payroll inputs, attendance discipline, grievance handling and disciplinary processes fairly and consistently.



**Franchise \& Multi\-City Support** 



* Define people standards, hiring frameworks and training expectations that franchise partners adopt to keep service quality consistent network\-wide.
* Act as the central HR point of contact for cluster managers in Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 8\+ years in HR, with at least 4 in a senior role within QSR, food \& beverage retail, organised retail or a multi\-outlet chain.
* Proven track record managing high\-volume frontline recruitment and reducing attrition in a shift\-based workforce.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi\-state statutory compliance.
* Experience standing up HR systems and processes in a scaling business — not just running an established one.
* Comfortable operating across multiple cities and stores, with willingness to travel.
* Hands\-on, founder\-mindset operator who can both set strategy and get into the detail.
* Fluency in English and Tamil; conversational Kannada and/or Telugu is a strong plus.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

title: Head of Talent Management
description:
Position Title: Talent Management \& Organizational Effectiveness
 



 Reporting To: Head HR NTBI
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





**Role Purpose (Why this role exists)** 




 To architect and drive NTBI's integrated talent strategy, ensuring that performance, potential, and culture are not siloed but fused into a cohesive engine that fuels business agility. This role is tasked with moving beyond traditional HR metrics to create a self\-sustaining talent ecosystem that anticipates future skill demands, de\-risks leadership pipelines, and embeds inclusion into the organizational DNA.
 



  





**Core Scope of Accountability** 




**1\. Performance Management \-** 
**From Evaluation to Enablement** 



* Implement the annual performance cycle into a continuous, real\-time feedback culture rather than a once\-a\-year compliance event.
* Drive the Goal Cascade across NTBI, ensuring every individual goal connects vertically to business strategy and horizontally to cross\-functional alignment.
* Implement Quality\-Adjusted Performance metrics... ensuring that output is measured not just by "what" but "how," integrating behavioral competencies and values.
* Lead the VC / Variable Pay calibration process, ensuring objective, fair, and defensible pay\-for\-performance decisions.



  





**2\. Succession \& HiPo Management** 
 \-
 **Building the Leadership Bench** 



* Develop and sustain a robust, data\-driven Succession Pipeline for all critical roles .
* Identify and nurture High\-Potential (HiPo) talent through structured interventions, not just assessments, but targeted developmental rotations, mentoring, and exposure.
* Create a "Ready\-Now" vs. "Future\-Ready" succession dashboard, ensuring the organization never operates with a single point of failure.
* Partner with business heads to de\-risk leadership continuity, especially in high\-impact engineering and R\&D functions.



  





**3\. Learning \& Development (L\&D) \- Future\-Skilling at Scale** 



* Shift L\&D from a "training calendar" to a capability / skills\-led transformation engine, focusing on future\-critical capabilities
* Design a skills taxonomy for NTBI in line with Nissan, mapping current vs. desired skills across the organization and driving targeted upskilling/reskilling interventions.
* Establish measurable L\&D ROI, linking learning completion to business outcomes (productivity, error reduction, innovation output).
* Drive certification partnerships with leading institutes and platforms to build technical and leadership depth.



  





**4\. Career Architecture \- Clarity, Mobility \& Growth** 



* Redesign the career framework, moving away from linear promotions to a multi\-dimensional career lattice that offers lateral moves, cross\-functional exposure, and skills\-based progression.
* Champion Internal Mobility \& IJP as a cultural norm, not an exception, ensuring that employees see growth pathways within NTBI rather than outside.
* Develop clear career pathways for high\-demand roles with transparent competency expectations at each level.



  





**5\. DEI – Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (Embedded, Not Add\-On)** 



* Shift DEI from a "check\-the\-box" metric to a business imperative—ensuring diversity in pipelines (campus hiring, laterals, leadership succession).
* Drive inclusive leadership by embedding DEI principles into performance assessments, hiring panels, and promotion decisions.
* Establish measurable DEI KPIs, gender parity at leadership levels, representation of underrepresented groups in STEM roles, and equitable pay analytics.
* Partner with Communications to tell authentic DEI stories that strengthen employer branding.



  





**6\. Culture \& Employee Experience \- The Invisible Force** 



* Design and drive Culture Roadmap for NTBI, ensuring values are not posters but lived behaviors.
* Lead the Employee Engagement / Pulse Survey strategy (including GES integration) and, more importantly, close the loop on Action Planning.
* Institutionalize continuous listening mechanisms, stay interviews, exit insights, and AI\-driven sentiment analysis, to proactively address friction points.
* Embed psychological safety and psychological ownership as measurable cultural outcomes.



**7\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning \- Strategic Sourcing to Onboarding** 



* Lead
 **end\-to\-end talent acquisition strategy** 
 , from demand forecasting to sourcing, selection, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with business growth and skill requirements.
* Drive
 **workforce planning** 
 in partnership with Finance and BU heads, translating business strategy into a forward\-looking talent demand map (GETs, laterals, leadership hires).
* Design and execute a
 **multi\-channel sourcing strategy** 
 , campus hiring (IITs/NITs/top engineering colleges), lateral hiring, niche skill acquisition (EV, ADAS, AI/ML, software\-defined vehicles), and executive search.
* Own the
 **employer branding** 
 narrative, positioning NTBI as an employer of choice in the automotive and technology ecosystem, both domestically and globally.
* Build a robust
 **intern\-to\-GET pipeline** 
 , ensuring seamless conversion and reducing time\-to\-productivity for fresh talent.
* Establish and track
 **TA metrics** 
 . Cost per Hire, Time to Fill, Quality of Hire, Offer Acceptance Rate, Diversity Sourcing and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with the C\&B team on
 **competitive benchmarking** 
 to ensure offers are market\-competitive and defensible.
* Ensure a
 **world\-class candidate experience** 
 , from application to onboarding, that reflects NTBI's culture and values.



  





 Professional Qualifications
 


* **Education.** 
 MBA from a top\-tier B\-School / PG in HR from a recognized institution

title: Head of Human Resources & Administration
description:
**Company Overview:** 




 IRISS is the global leader in industrial safety and condition\-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide. We design and manufacture in our facility in Bradenton Florida (made in the USA) innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected — helping organizations prevent failure, reduce risk, and protect their people.
 



 IRISS has its headquarters in the U.S. with operations across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India. At our core is a simple idea with profound impact: We Humanize Safety. That means creating products and technologies that are not only advanced, but intuitive, empowering, and designed with people in mind.
 



 We’re shaping the future of how industries work — and how workers stay safe
 



  





***Please review our website and YouTube to learn more about our products and who we are:***




  





**Electrical Maintenance Safety Solutions \| IRISS Inc** 




 https://iriss.com/
 



**IRISS \- YouTube** 




 https://www.youtube.com/@Irissemsd
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced HR leader to manage Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Compliance, and Administration for our India operations. The role will oversee workforce planning, recruitment, employee engagement, statutory compliance, performance management, and office/facility administration across both manufacturing and commercial functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for manufacturing, Production Supervisors, Operators, Technicians, Sales Managers, Regional Sales Engineers.
 



 · Establish HR policies, processes, and systems for India operations.
 



 · Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
 



 · Manage employee relations, disciplinary matters, grievance handling, and industrial relations.
 



 · Drive performance management, training, employee engagement, and organizational development initiatives.
 



 · Oversee payroll inputs, employee records, and HR documentation.
 



 · Manage administration, facilities, security, housekeeping, and vendor contracts for Chennai and Bangalore locations.
 



 · Partner with leadership on workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational growth.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 · Timely closure of approved positions.
 



 · Annual employee attrition within target levels.
 



 · 100% statutory compliance and timely filings.
 



 · Zero major compliance violations or labour disputes.
 



 · Successful implementation of performance management processes.
 



 · Employee engagement and retention targets achieved.
 



 · Administration and facility budgets maintained within approved limits.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 · MBA/PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Labour Welfare, or equivalent.
 



 · 12\+ years of HR experience, including experience in manufacturing organizations.
 



 · Strong knowledge of labour laws, factory compliance, and industrial relations.
 



 · Experience supporting both factory and sales/commercial teams preferred.
 



 · Experience in setting up HR processes for a growing organization is highly desirable.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 · Opportunity to build and lead the HR function for India /APAC operations.
 



 · Strategic leadership role with exposure to global management.
 



 · Dynamic and growth\-oriented work environment.
